newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Alliance may cut aircraft purchase costs - Lufthansa.
newsitem.headline: Alliance may cut aircraft purchase costs - Lufthansa.

text.p: The new "Star Alliance" linking five airlines could lead to savings in aircraft purchases, Deutsche Lufthansa AG, one of the alliance partners, said on Thursday.

"We are looking at all aspects of savings. This also includes aircraft purchases for that matter," Jurgen Thomsen, Lufthansa's general manager for southern China, Hong Kong and Macau, told reporters in Hong Kong.
The "Star Alliance" also includes United Airlines, Air Canada, Scandinavian Airlines Systems and Thai Airways International Ltd.
